Name: Flowergrass and Snowfields
Author: Alvadea
Description:
[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/EiQV3kT.png[/img][/center]


[center][img]https://imgur.com/br9RloX.png[/img]

[color=#c9b490][size=3] This is a content pack for the "More Grass" mod. As such it gives the grass a new look with a wider range of grass and flower types. I tried to create a look with more colorful flowers as in the vanilla game while also keeping its wild touch. It's still a grassland - not a cultivated garden. Also there is now snow on the grass growing in winter! This improves the feeling of a cold, snowy winter a lot! :D

"Flowergrass and Snowfields" is available in 6 different versions to match the most common Stardew Valley Recolors. These are:[/size][/color]


[color=#c9b490][size=3]Vanilla Color (of course)[/size][/color]
[color=#c9b490][size=3]DaisyNiko's Earthy Recolour[/size][/color]
[color=#c9b490][size=3]Starblue Valley World Recolor[/size][/color]
[color=#c9b490][size=3]Vibrant Pastoral Recolor[/size][/color]
[color=#c9b490][size=3]Eemie's Map Recolors[/size][/color]
[color=#c9b490][size=3]A Wittily Named Recolor[/size][/color]

[color=#c9b490][size=3] Tipp: If you feel like the Vanilla Version is too bight for you and you liked the calmer view before the update - choose Eemie's Version instead. It's not much of a color difference here, so it works absolutely fine with the Vanilla Map Colors. It's only a little less saturated. [/size][/color][/center]

[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/4HgJ9np.png[/img][/center]

[*] [color=#c9b490][size=3]Download and install the latest version of[/size][/color][size=3] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5398] More Grass[/url][/size]
